subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram expose pinned-message reads to agents, and should the first version be on-demand only behind an explicit action/config gate rather than automatic session-start context injection?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how persistent Telegram room context is authorized, fetched, exposed to prompts, and documented.

options.title: Approve gated on-demand reads
options.body: Add a Telegram `list-pins`/read-pinned action behind an explicit gate, document the current-pinned-message-only contract, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Design auto-fetch separately
options.body: Keep this issue open for the on-demand action while requiring a separate design decision before any session-start prompt injection.

options.title: Defer pinned reads
options.body: Do not expose pinned-message content through the built-in Telegram message tool until maintainers settle a broader Telegram history/context policy.

recommendation.title: Approve gated on-demand reads
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram `list-pins`/read-pinned action behind an explicit gate, document the current-pinned-message-only contract, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security boundary decision, and steipete is the strongest visible reviewer signal from the related Telegram read review context.
